# Office Facilities & Workplace

## 1. Locations
- **HQ:** 100 Main Street, City Center
- **Branch:** 45 Tech Park, Innovation District

## 2. Access & Badges
- Badges are issued by Facilities on day one.
- Lost badges must be reported immediately; replacement fee: $25.
- Do not tailgate or lend badges to visitors.

## 3. Desks & Meeting Rooms
- Hot-desking applies on floors 3–5; reserve via the **Room Booking System**.
- Meeting rooms must be released if unused after **15 minutes**.
- Keep calls in phone booths or designated zones.

## 4. Parking
- Available on a first-come, first-served basis.
- Reserved spots require a permit from Facilities.
- EV charging stations: 4 spots on Level B1.

## 5. Kitchen & Supplies
- Coffee, tea, and snacks are provided on each floor.
- Label personal food; unlabeled items are discarded on Fridays.
- Clean up after yourself; report spills to Facilities ext. 5600.

## 6. Mail & Packages
- Deliveries are received at the mailroom (Ground Floor).
- Notifications are sent when packages arrive.
- Personal deliveries should be limited.

## 7. Maintenance
- Report facility issues via the Facilities Portal or ext. 5600.
- Emergency (water leak, power outage): ext. 5911.

## 8. Dress Code
- Business casual Monday–Thursday.
- Casual Friday is permitted (no beachwear).
- Client-facing days: business formal.

# Information Security Policy

## 1. Scope
Applies to all employees, contractors, and third parties with access to company systems or data.

## 2. Data Classification
| Level      | Description                          | Examples                      |
|------------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| Public     | Safe for public release              | Marketing materials           |
| Internal   | Internal use only                    | Org charts, policies          |
| Confidential | Business-sensitive                 | Financials, contracts         |
| Restricted | Regulated / highly sensitive         | PII, credentials, health data |

- **Restricted** data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

## 3. Acceptable Use
- Company devices are for business use; limited personal use is permitted.
- Do not install unauthorized software or bypass security controls.
- Do not use company email for illegal, harassing, or discriminatory content.

## 4. Incident Response
- Report incidents (phishing, lost device, breach) to **security@company.com** or ext. 5911 **immediately**.
- Do not attempt to investigate or remediate alone.
- Preserve evidence; do not delete logs or files.

## 5. Phishing & Social Engineering
- Verify sender addresses and links before clicking.
- Report suspicious emails using the **Report Phishing** button.
- IT will never ask for your password via email or phone.

## 6. Access Control
- Follow **least privilege** and **need-to-know** principles.
- Access reviews are conducted quarterly.
- Access must be revoked within 24 hours of termination.

## 7. Encryption & Devices
- Full-disk encryption is mandatory on all laptops.
- Removable media must be company-approved and encrypted.
- Lock your screen when leaving your desk (Win+L / Ctrl+Cmd+Q).

## 8. Compliance
- Comply with GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and local regulations.
- Violations may result in disciplinary action up to termination.

# IT Support & Systems

## 1. Helpdesk
- **Email:** it-support@company.com
- **Phone:** Ext. 5555
- **Portal:** https://helpdesk.company.com
- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Mon–Fri); on-call for P1 incidents.

### Ticket Priority Levels
| Priority | Description                        | Response SLA | Resolution SLA |
|----------|------------------------------------|--------------|----------------|
| P1       | Critical outage / security breach  | 15 min       | 4 hours        |
| P2       | Major functionality impacted       | 1 hour       | 8 hours        |
| P3       | Minor issue / workaround available | 4 hours      | 3 days         |
| P4       | Request / question                 | 1 day        | 5 days         |

## 2. Laptop & Equipment
- Standard issue: company laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse, headset.
- Replacement requests require manager approval for items over $200.
- Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT **within 24 hours**.

## 3. Software
- Only approved software from the **Software Catalog** may be installed.
- New software requests go through the IT portal and require a security review.
- Unlicensed software is strictly prohibited.

## 4. Accounts & Passwords
- Passwords must be **at least 12 characters** with mixed case, numbers, and symbols.
- Password rotation: every **90 days**.
- MFA is mandatory for all company accounts.
- Never share credentials. Report suspected compromise immediately.

## 5. VPN & Remote Access
- VPN is required when accessing internal systems outside the office.
- Use the company-provided VPN client only.
- Do not connect to untrusted public Wi-Fi without VPN.

## 6. Backups
- Company data is backed up nightly.
- Personal files must be stored in OneDrive/SharePoint, not local drives.
- Recovery requests: submit a ticket with file paths and dates.

## 7. Network
- Guest Wi-Fi: `Company-Guest` (password from reception).
- Corporate Wi-Fi: `Company-Secure` (domain credentials required).
- Report connectivity issues with the ticket tool including traceroute output.

# Human Resources (HR) Policy

## 1. Working Hours
- Standard working hours are **9:00 AM – 6:00 PM**, Monday to Friday.
- A one-hour lunch break is included.
- Flexible start times (8:00 AM – 10:00 AM) are permitted with manager approval.

## 2. Leave Policy
| Leave Type       | Days per Year | Notes                          |
|------------------|---------------|--------------------------------|
| Annual Leave     | 20            | Accrued monthly                |
| Sick Leave       | 10            | Medical certificate if > 2 days|
| Casual Leave     | 5             | Max 2 consecutive days         |
| Parental Leave   | 90            | Paid, per child                |
| Bereavement      | 5             | Immediate family               |

- Leave requests must be submitted **at least 3 working days** in advance via the HR portal.
- Unused annual leave can be carried over up to **5 days** into the next year.

## 3. Payroll
- Salaries are paid on the **last working day** of each month.
- Payslips are available on the HR portal by the 1st of the following month.
- Queries about payroll must be raised within **30 days** of the payslip date.

## 4. Performance Reviews
- Conducted **twice a year** (mid-year and annual).
- Ratings range from 1 (Needs Improvement) to 5 (Outstanding).
- Promotions are considered during the annual review cycle.

## 5. Onboarding
- New employees receive an onboarding pack on day one.
- A 90-day probation period applies to all new hires.
- Buddy assignment is mandatory for the first 30 days.

## 6. Exit Process
- Submit resignation with **60 days' notice**.
- Exit interviews are mandatory.
- Full and final settlement is processed within **45 days**.

## 7. Contact
- HR Helpdesk: hr@company.com
- HR Portal: https://hr.company.com

# Business Travel Policy

## 1. Approval
- All business travel requires **manager approval** before booking.
- International travel also requires **VP approval**.
- Submit requests at least **14 days** in advance (domestic) and **30 days** (international).

## 2. Booking
- Book through the **Corporate Travel Portal** only.
- Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy for 6+ hours.
- Business class requires Director approval.
- Use preferred hotel and car rental vendors for negotiated rates.

## 3. Expenses
| Category        | Limit                         |
|-----------------|-------------------------------|
| Hotel           | $250/night (domestic)         |
| Meals           | $60/day (domestic)            |
| Meals           | $90/day (international)       |
| Ground transport| Reasonable / actual cost      |

- Itemized receipts are required for all expenses over $25.
- Submit expense reports within **30 days** of trip completion.
- Alcohol is reimbursable only for client entertainment with prior approval.

## 4. Air Travel
- Book **21+ days** in advance when possible.
- Frequent flyer miles may be accrued personally; upgrades at personal cost.
- Cancel unused flights promptly to avoid fees.

## 5. Ground Transportation
- Prefer airport shuttles or public transport where practical.
- Ride-sharing (Uber/Lyft) is permitted; choose standard tiers.
- Rental cars require prior approval and must be compact/mid-size unless justified.

## 6. International Travel
- Check visa and passport validity (6+ months remaining).
- Register your trip in the **Travel Safety Portal**.
- Ensure travel insurance is active; policy details in the portal.
- Follow local laws and customs; report safety concerns to security@company.com.

## 7. Personal Travel Combined with Business
- Personal days may be added at your own expense.
- Any cost difference must be clearly documented and approved.

## 8. Emergencies
- Contact the **24/7 Travel Assistance Line:** +1-800-555-0199.
- Notify your manager and HR of any medical or security incidents.
